title: A Product Passport for European Wool
subtitle: What the Digital Product Passport asks of a Dutch wool supplier, and why the hardest problem lies with a single European dataset. Regen Studio and CircularTech Forum worked it out with Hollands Wol Collectief.
featuredImageAlt: A flock of faceted, low-poly sheep in yellow, cream and dark brown, illustrating a product passport for European wool
excerpt: Hollands Wol Collectief, a Rotterdam supplier of scoured Dutch wool and felt, explored with Regen Studio and CircularTech Forum what the Digital Product Passport means for wool. We scored 76 data points and found that Europe's reference database holds one wool dataset, mostly Australian and New Zealand, in which one method choice can double the result. We propose a European approach.
